Why Hairzen?

A hair transplant is done once and you live with the result for years. The five things our patients value most:

  1. 01

    Sterile environment

    Operations take place in an operating room prepared to hospital standards. Single-use consumables and freshly sterilised surgical sets are used for every patient.

  2. 02

    Expert team

    Doğukan Denli designs your hairline himself. His experienced team is with you at every step of graft extraction and placement.

  3. 03

    Patient satisfaction

    The recommendations of more than 5,000 patients are our best reference. We listen to your expectations and plan the result with you from the start.

  4. 04

    Latest technology

    With sapphire blades, Choi implanter pens and micromotor systems, grafts are extracted and placed with less trauma.

  5. 05

    24/7 professional support

    Before and after your operation, you can reach us any time of day by WhatsApp or phone with any question.

How the first year goes

The transplant takes one day, but the result shows over a year. A patient who knows what happens each month is not alarmed by the shedding in month three.

  1. Transplant day

    Local anaesthesia, 6–8 hours. You return to your hotel in the evening.

  2. Day 3

    The first wash is done at the clinic and the bandage comes off.

  3. Day 10

    The scabs fall off and you can go back to work.

  4. Months 1–3

    The transplanted hairs shed. This is shock loss and it is expected; the roots stay in place.

  5. Months 4–6

    New hairs grow in thin and gradually thicken.

  6. Month 9

    Most of the result is visible and the hair starts to take shape.

  7. Month 12

    Final check-up and photos. The crown can keep improving until month 18.

Our services

For hair, beard and women's hair transplants, we choose your method together based on your hair type, the size of the bald area and your expectations.

01

FUE Hair Transplant

Grafts are taken one by one from the back and sides and placed into fine channels.

  • For large bald areas
  • High graft count in one session
  • Fine channels with sapphire blades
Get details
02

DHI Hair Transplant

With the Choi pen, grafts are placed directly without opening channels first.

  • Possible without shaving
  • Dense, natural hairline
  • Shorter scabbing
Get details
03

Beard Transplant

Sparse or empty beard areas are filled with your own follicles.

  • Personal beard line
  • Local anaesthesia
  • Cheek and moustache densifying
Get details
04

Women's Hair Transplant

Thinning areas are densified without touching your existing hair.

  • Unshaven DHI technique
  • Parting line densifying
  • Natural density plan

Frequently asked questions

Does a hair transplant hurt?

You only feel a few minutes of stinging during the local anaesthetic injections. After that you can watch a film, chat and have lunch during the procedure.

Will the transplanted hair fall out again?

Grafts are taken from the back and sides of the head. Follicles there are resistant to the hormone that causes hair loss and keep this resistance in their new place. Your existing, non-transplanted hair may continue to thin, so we give you a medication and PRP plan.

Who is not suitable for a hair transplant?

People with a weak donor area, uncontrolled diabetes or heart disease, and very young patients whose hair loss has not yet stabilised. If the photo analysis shows you are not suitable, we will tell you openly.

When can I go back to work?

With a desk job you can return on day 3; wearing a hat is not recommended until day 10. Wait a month before heavy exercise and swimming.

Do you perform hair transplants for women?

Yes. For women we usually use unshaven DHI to lower the hairline or densify the parting.
